decision: Record the gap reproduced for both frozen quarter-v2 sources and exact-archive replay. Design an offline successor that durably represents local reservation state without inventing a service submission or venue charge. No live deployment change is proposed.
falsifier: If the accepted reservation is already durable before begin, the restarted observation occurs after its expiry, the original source differs, or any pre-begin service dispatch occurred, the corresponding boundary classification must be revised.
hypothesis: A successful original quarter-v2 local budget acquisition can be lost across process death before the portable attempt journal commits begin.
limitations: The exact failure interval is deliberately suspended; natural failure frequency is not estimated.
Only the first original BTC candle request and two applicable quarter-v2 versions were probed.
The probe uses original real clocks and actual process death but synthetic service infrastructure under OS network denial.
No power-loss/reboot, whole-service restart, full-window capacity or economic result is established.
A durable-reservation repair remains unimplemented and unqualified.
